headline: Schefter: WR is the position to watch; Jaguars "warming" to Brian Thomas Jr. trade
details: On Sunday NFL Countdown, Schefter said the Colts want a third-round pick for Josh Downs, the Jaguars are warming to the idea of trading Brian Thomas Jr., the Browns are open to moving Jerry Jeudy, Minnesota would listen on Jauan Jennings, and Calvin Ridley and Hollywood Brown could be had.
fantasy: A Brian Thomas Jr. deal would open targets for Parker Washington and Brenton Strange. A Josh Downs trade helps Keenan Allen in Indianapolis.
affects: Brian Thomas Jr.; Parker Washington; Brenton Strange; Trevor Lawrence; Josh Downs; Keenan Allen

headline: Chiefs and Bengals monitoring Jonathan Taylor; Schultz says a trade is "more likely than not"
details: James Palmer reports Kansas City is monitoring Taylor and Jordan Schultz says Cincinnati has checked in. Jeremy Fowler named running back as a position Seattle could target. Schultz says it is "more likely than not" the Colts trade Taylor; Indy already rejected a second-round-plus offer.
fantasy: A move to Cincinnati would hit Chase Brown hardest; Kansas City would cut into Kenneth Walker III. Seth McGowan becomes a starter in any Taylor deal.
affects: Jonathan Taylor; Seth McGowan; Chase Brown; Kenneth Walker III; Jadarian Price

headline: Broncos in "hot pursuit" of Jonathan Taylor: "This could happen at any moment"
details: A report says the Broncos "are going to try to pull this trade off" after placing RJ Harvey on IR. The Colts are reportedly seeking a package like the 2022 McCaffrey trade (second, third, fourth and fifth-round picks).
fantasy: Taylor in Denver would push Jonah Coleman and J.K. Dobbins into backup roles; Seth McGowan would start in Indianapolis.
affects: Jonathan Taylor; Seth McGowan; J.K. Dobbins; Jonah Coleman; RJ Harvey

headline: Schefter names Titans WR Calvin Ridley as a potential trade candidate
details: ESPN's Adam Schefter listed Calvin Ridley among the receivers who could be moved before the Nov. 10 deadline.
fantasy: Ridley is not rostered in the league. A trade would reshape the Titans' passing game, the opponent this week for André's Bengals D/ST.

headline: Schefter: Raiders not planning to trade Maxx Crosby, who wants to stay
details: League sources say the 3-4 Raiders have had no trade discussions about Crosby this season and have no plans to move him. One source said Crosby does not want to leave Las Vegas under any circumstances.
fantasy: No direct fantasy effect; the Raiders defense keeps its top pass rusher.

headline: Five teams pursue Jonathan Taylor: Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Giants and Seahawks
details: Denver, Green Bay, Minnesota, the Giants and Seattle are named as interested. The Colts (2-5) reportedly want significant compensation, and there is no guarantee Taylor is moved before the Nov. 10 deadline. Taylor has 587 rushing yards and 8 TDs through seven games.
fantasy: A deal to Minnesota would hurt Jordan Mason; to Green Bay it would cloud Josh Jacobs; to the Giants it would hit Cam Skattebo. Seth McGowan would gain in Indianapolis if Taylor leaves.
affects: Jordan Mason; Josh Jacobs; Cam Skattebo; Seth McGowan; Jonathan Taylor

headline: The Athletic: Vikings and Giants appear to be favorites for Jonathan Taylor
details: Jonathan Jones says Minnesota and New York lead the Taylor market, though the Vikings' cap room is a problem. ESPN's Jordan Raanan says the Colts want a second-round pick and possibly more.
fantasy: A Vikings deal would push Jordan Mason into a backup role; a Giants deal would cut into Cam Skattebo's workload. Seth McGowan would gain in Indianapolis.
affects: Jordan Mason; Cam Skattebo; Seth McGowan

headline: Josina Anderson: Colts are not "now" open to trading Jonathan Taylor
details: Anderson disputed the Schefter/Rapoport framing, saying a desire for a first-round pick and a defensive tackle was discussed in exploratory talks earlier in the week.
fantasy: Conflicting reports lower the odds of a quick deal, which is mild relief for Jordan Mason in Minnesota.
affects: Jordan Mason; Seth McGowan; Cam Skattebo

headline: Schefter: Colts open to trading Jonathan Taylor; ESPN lists Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Giants and Seahawks as interested
details: Schefter reports multiple teams have reached out and talks are active and ongoing. ESPN's reporting names Denver, Green Bay, Minnesota, the Giants and Seattle as teams with at least some interest; Jeremy Fowler puts the price at a second-round pick and more.
fantasy: A Taylor deal to Minnesota would cut into Jordan Mason, to Seattle into Jadarian Price, to Green Bay into Josh Jacobs, to Denver into RJ Harvey, and to the Giants into Cam Skattebo. Seth McGowan would gain in Indianapolis.
affects: Jordan Mason; Jadarian Price; Josh Jacobs; RJ Harvey; Cam Skattebo; Seth McGowan

headline: Pelissero: Jaguars continue to receive trade interest in Brian Thomas Jr.
details: Jacksonville keeps getting calls on Thomas, with any deal likely closer to the Nov. 10 deadline. He has 9 catches for 105 yards in six games behind Parker Washington and Jakobi Meyers.
fantasy: A move could restore Brian Thomas Jr.'s value for Gevers and consolidate targets for Parker Washington and Brenton Strange in Jacksonville.
affects: Brian Thomas Jr.; Parker Washington; Trevor Lawrence; Brenton Strange

headline: Colts fielding calls for Josh Downs; Schultz expects a trade before the deadline
details: Pelissero says calls came in before Downs requested a trade. Jordan Schultz reports the Steelers are among multiple AFC teams interested and expects Downs to be dealt before Nov. 10, though not this week.
fantasy: Keenan Allen would absorb more targets in Indianapolis. A move to Pittsburgh would crowd Germie Bernard.
affects: Keenan Allen; Alec Pierce; Germie Bernard

headline: Patriots sign RB Lan Larison to the 53-man roster, elevate WR Ryan Miller
details: New England made the moves Saturday after ruling out A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) and TreVeyon Henderson (illness) for Sunday at Miami. Rhamondre Stevenson leads the backfield with Corey Kiner as the next man up.
fantasy: Confirms TreVeyon Henderson is out and A.J. Brown won't play, so both need to stay out of Wesley's lineup.

headline: Pelissero: Colts immediately rejected a second-round-plus offer for Jonathan Taylor
details: Pelissero says the Colts are not in fire-sale mode and may want a package like the 2022 McCaffrey trade (second-, third- and fourth-round picks plus a fifth). The Athletic's James Boyd says Indianapolis is not shopping Taylor but is listening. Taylor is due about $4.9 million for the rest of 2026, and his $15 million 2027 salary becomes fully guaranteed after the Super Bowl. Shane Steichen said Taylor plays Sunday at Jacksonville.
fantasy: The asking price is high, so a deal is not certain. Seth McGowan stays a handcuff until something happens; Josh Jacobs, Jordan Mason, Jadarian Price and RJ Harvey are the rostered backs a trade could squeeze.
affects: Seth McGowan; Josh Jacobs; Jordan Mason; Jadarian Price; RJ Harvey

headline: Packers among teams interested in Jonathan Taylor as Josh Jacobs' legal case lingers
details: Green Bay is on the list of interested teams reported by Schefter and Rapoport. Jacobs missed the first six games on the Commissioner's Exempt List and has played two games since returning; the NFL has not ruled on a suspension.
fantasy: A Taylor trade to Green Bay, or a Jacobs suspension, would sharply cut Josh Jacobs' value for Carlier.

headline: Colts now open to trading Jonathan Taylor; multiple teams have called
details: Schefter reported Saturday that Indianapolis is open to dealing Taylor and that talks are active and ongoing. Teams thought to have at least some interest: Broncos, Packers, Vikings, Giants and Seahawks. Taylor is under contract for $15 million in 2027 and $9.46 million in 2028. Ian Rapoport also reported it. ESPN later added that the Colts have received at least one offer including a second-round pick plus more.
fantasy: A trade would make Seth McGowan Indianapolis' lead back. Landing in Minnesota would hurt Jordan Mason, Seattle would hurt Jadarian Price, Green Bay would cut into Josh Jacobs' role, and Denver would squeeze RJ Harvey.
affects: Seth McGowan; Jordan Mason; Jadarian Price; Josh Jacobs; RJ Harvey

headline: Schefter: "No way" the Jets trade Garrett Wilson before the deadline
details: A source told ESPN the Jets have no interest in moving Wilson, 26, who signed a four-year, $130 million extension 15 months ago, and ownership wants no part of trading him. The 49ers are still looking for receiver help, per The Athletic's Jonathan Jones.
fantasy: Wilson stays, so Omar Cooper Jr.'s target competition in New York does not change.

headline: Garafolo discusses Eagles deadline options: Goedert, Dickerson, Jihaad Campbell
details: On PHLY Sports, NFL Network's Mike Garafolo discussed the names floating in Eagles trade talk: Dallas Goedert, Landon Dickerson and Jihaad Campbell. These are names being discussed, not a reported deal.
fantasy: Adds to the Fox Sports report that Philadelphia will listen on Goedert. No effect on Sunday night; watch for a move before Nov. 10.

headline: Rapoport: Khalil Mack is "another big-time name" to watch before the deadline
details: After the Bears landed Jeffery Simmons, Rapoport said Mack will be discussed before Nov. 10. Bears GM Ryan Poles said Chicago has to be "very smart" after that deal, and SI's Albert Breer reports the Chargers have not engaged on Mack and seem unwilling to wave the white flag.
fantasy: No direct effect on your roster.

headline: Colts WR Josh Downs reportedly requests a trade
details: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reported Downs asked to be moved as Indianapolis sells veterans. Coach Shane Steichen said Jonathan Taylor has not requested a trade.
fantasy: Indicates the Colts' teardown continues, but Taylor staying keeps Seth McGowan a handcuff only.

headline: Cardinals sign WR Zay Jones
details: Arizona adds a veteran receiver after trading Marvin Harrison Jr. to Houston.
fantasy: A small depth boost for Arizona's passing game, slightly helpful for Chad Ryland's scoring chances.

headline: Eagles expected to field offers on Dallas Goedert, Landon Dickerson and Riq Woolen
details: The 2-5 Eagles are open to dealing veterans before the Nov. 10 deadline. Goedert is on a one-year deal with void years, so a trade would leave about $28 million in dead money over this year and next.
fantasy: A trade would move Goedert to a new offense mid-season; his target share could rise or fall depending on the destination. No effect on this Sunday.

headline: Insider: "All hell is going to break loose" before the deadline
details: Jordan Schultz says GMs expect a busier deadline than usual. Schefter has noted there were 18 trades between Oct. 1 and the deadline in each of the last two years, and this year could top that. Names in circulation include Khalil Mack, Jonathan Taylor, Josh Downs, Brian Thomas Jr., Jauan Jennings and Zach Sieler.
fantasy: Two of those names touch your players: a Taylor deal would make Seth McGowan Indianapolis' lead back, and a Thomas deal would boost Parker Washington's targets.
affects: Seth McGowan; Parker Washington; Brian Thomas Jr.

headline: Bears acquire DT Jeffery Simmons from the Titans
details: Chicago gets Simmons and a 2028 fifth-round pick. Tennessee gets 2027 and 2028 first-round picks plus a 2027 fourth-round pick.
fantasy: Tennessee loses its best run defender right before facing Cincinnati, which helps Tee Higgins and the Bengals offense. Chicago's line gets tougher for Seattle's backfield on Monday night, which matters if Jadarian Price is activated.
affects: Tee Higgins; Jadarian Price; Chase Brown

headline: Jaguars not engaging in Brian Thomas Jr. trade talks, for now
details: Schefter and Ian Rapoport report that Jacksonville has shown no sign of shopping Thomas, but calls are expected to pick up before the deadline. Thomas has lost snaps to rookie Josh Cameron, and Liam Coen called his confidence "week to week."
fantasy: Parker Washington has become Jacksonville's top target. A Thomas trade would push even more volume his way, and Lawrence would lose a deep threat.
affects: Parker Washington; Trevor Lawrence; Brian Thomas Jr.

headline: Eagles promote RB Jaydon Blue to the active roster
details: Blue moves up from Philadelphia's practice squad. Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) is banged up, and Tank Bigsby, Will Shipley and Dameon Pierce are on IR.
fantasy: ESPN still lists Blue as a free agent, but he could get touches Sunday night if Barkley sits.

headline: Seahawks acquire G Quenton Nelson from the Colts
details: Seattle sends a 2027 third-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick to Indianapolis for Nelson, who is on an expiring contract. Ian Rapoport also reported the deal.
fantasy: Seattle's run blocking gets a major upgrade, good news for Jadarian Price once he's back. The Colts lose their best blocker, a downgrade for their backfield including Seth McGowan.
affects: Jadarian Price; Seth McGowan; Keenan Allen

headline: 49ers acquire DT DeForest Buckner from the Colts
details: Indianapolis gets a 2027 fourth-round pick. Ian Rapoport also reported the deal.
fantasy: The Colts' defensive line is weaker heading into Sunday at Jacksonville, a small upgrade for Trevor Lawrence and Parker Washington.

headline: Colts ownership doesn't want to trade Jonathan Taylor
details: Even with Indianapolis selling veterans after firing GM Chris Ballard, the owner wants to keep Taylor. Taylor says he hasn't asked for a trade.
fantasy: Superseded on Oct. 31, when Schefter reported the Colts are now open to trading Taylor.

headline: Schefter expects "double-digit" trades before the Nov. 10 deadline
details: On The Pat McAfee Show he named the Colts as the likeliest sellers and compared a possible Jonathan Taylor deal to the 2022 Christian McCaffrey trade (roughly a second- and a fifth-round pick). He also flagged Brian Thomas Jr. and Khalil Mack as names to watch.
fantasy: Expect more moves this week and next. A Taylor trade would make McGowan the Colts' starter, and a Thomas trade would boost Parker Washington.

headline: Vikings linked to a running back with "home-run burst"
details: Minnesota could add a running back before the deadline.
fantasy: An outside addition would cut into both Jordan Mason's and Aaron Jones' roles.

headline: Dolphins expected to be major sellers, open to offers on almost anyone
details: Zach Sieler, Austin Jackson, Josh Uche and Willie Gay Jr. are named as likely trade candidates as Miami looks ahead to the 2027 draft.
fantasy: No direct impact on your roster.

headline: Schefter names Dolphins, Chargers, Titans and Cardinals as deadline sellers
details: All four were expected to move veterans for future picks. Arizona had already traded Marvin Harrison Jr.
fantasy: If Arizona sells more veterans, its offense could weaken further, which would cost Chad Ryland field-goal chances.

headline: Texans acquire WR Marvin Harrison Jr. from the Cardinals
details: Houston gets Harrison and a 2027 seventh-round pick. Arizona gets 2027 second- and sixth-round picks. Schefter first reported Arizona was "finalizing a deal" on Oct. 10, with Ian Rapoport.
fantasy: Arizona lost its top receiver, which means fewer scoring drives and fewer kicks for Chad Ryland.

headline: Ravens acquire C Cam Jurgens from the Eagles
details: Baltimore gets Jurgens and a 2027 seventh-round pick. Philadelphia gets a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick.
fantasy: The Eagles' interior line is thinner in front of backup QB Tanner McKee, a slight drag on Dallas Goedert.

headline: Cowboys acquire CB Joey Porter Jr. from the Steelers
details: Pittsburgh gets a 2027 sixth-round pick and a 2028 second-round pick.
fantasy: Dallas' secondary is stronger. Arizona plays at Dallas this Sunday, a small downgrade for Chad Ryland's chances.

headline: Giants acquire QB J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings
details: Minnesota gets a 2027 fifth-round pick. Kyler Murray is Minnesota's starter.
fantasy: No change to your Vikings players. Murray stays the starter.

headline: Schefter and Rapoport: at least four teams vying for Jonathan Taylor, Colts in active talks
details: Schefter and Ian Rapoport report the Colts are in active trade talks on Jonathan Taylor with at least four teams interested, including the Broncos.
fantasy: A Taylor trade would open the Colts backfield for Seth McGowan and could cloud J.K. Dobbins and Jonah Coleman in Denver.
affects: Jonathan Taylor; Seth McGowan; J.K. Dobbins

headline: Rapoport: Chiefs want a receiver; Brian Thomas Jr. and Josh Downs named as targets
details: Ian Rapoport reports Kansas City is interested in adding a wide receiver, naming Jacksonville's Brian Thomas Jr. and Indianapolis's Josh Downs as targets.
fantasy: A Brian Thomas Jr. trade would push more targets to Parker Washington and Brenton Strange in Jacksonville and add competition for Xavier Worthy and Rashee Rice.
affects: Brian Thomas Jr.; Parker Washington; Brenton Strange; Trevor Lawrence; Xavier Worthy; Rashee Rice

headline: Eagles won't trade Saquon Barkley before the deadline
details: Mike Garafolo and Ian Rapoport report Philadelphia will not trade Saquon Barkley.
fantasy: Saquon Barkley stays the Eagles lead back, so Wesley's starter keeps his role.

headline: Glazer: 49ers and Vikings agreed on terms for Jauan Jennings, but Jennings killed the deal
details: Jay Glazer reports San Francisco and Minnesota had worked out a trade that would have returned WR Jauan Jennings to the 49ers before Jennings nixed it.
fantasy: No change for now; Jennings staying in Minnesota keeps him competing with Justin Jefferson and T.J. Hockenson for targets.

headline: Schefter: Cowboys connected again to Cardinals OLB Josh Sweat
details: Adam Schefter reports Dallas is again linked to a trade for Arizona edge rusher Josh Sweat.
fantasy: A Sweat addition would boost the Cowboys D/ST pass rush.

headline: Schefter: Texans DE Jadeveon Clowney emerging as a trade candidate
details: Adam Schefter names Houston edge rusher Jadeveon Clowney as an emerging trade candidate.

headline: Ravens' top pursuit is Bears backup QB Tyson Bagent
details: La Canfora reports Baltimore has already reached out to Chicago; Mike Florio says the Ravens may explore it and that "it won't be cheap." Bagent makes $4M this year and next.
fantasy: A Bagent trade would steady the Ravens' offense for Derrick Henry, Zay Flowers and Mark Andrews while Lamar Jackson is on IR.
affects: Derrick Henry; Zay Flowers; Mark Andrews; Tyler Loop

headline: Schefter: Taylor trade "in play" up to the deadline; Colts "don't want to just give him away"
details: On Monday's Get Up, Schefter said a lot of teams are interested in Jonathan Taylor and the Colts are open to dealing him at the right price.
fantasy: Seth McGowan would take over in Indianapolis if Taylor is traded.
